message.content:
Step 1: Identify the singer-songwriter born in May of 1942. According to the source [Tammy Wynette], Tammy Wynette was born on May 5, 1942, and was an American country music singer-songwriter.
Step 2: Identify the song "The Battle" and the duet mentioned. According to the source [The Battle (George Jones song)], "The Battle" is a song by George Jones. The source also mentions that the single "Golden Ring," a duet with his estranged ex-wife Tammy Wynette, became a #1 hit that same year.
Step 3: Combine the information. Tammy Wynette is the American country music singer-songwriter born in May 1942 who sang a duet with her ex-husband (George Jones) the same year he released "The Battle."

Final answer: Tammy Wynette
message.reasoning:
The question asks for an American country music singer-songwriter, born in May of 1942, who sang a duet with her ex-husband the same year that he released the song "The Battle".

Looking at the sources:
- [Tammy Wynette]: Tammy Wynette (born Virginia Wynette Pugh; May 5, 1942 – April 6, 1998) was an American country music singer-songwriter...
- [The Battle (George Jones song)]: "The Battle" is a song by American country music artist George Jones. ... Meanwhile, the single "Golden Ring," a duet with his estranged ex-wife Tammy Wynette, became a #1 hit that same year.

So Tammy Wynette was born in May of 1942, and she sang a duet with George Jones (her ex-husband) the same year he released "The Battle".

The answer is Tammy Wynette.
